title: The Wet Paint Signed by the Helper Too
youtube_title: The Wet Paint Signed by the Helper Too | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: A thank-you that takes effort feels true.
summary: At a library corner with a paper ribbon in a book, Gita notices that Mr. Ade has already taken care of a helper's tiny mark beside yours on the underside, not stealing the front. A quick thank-you feels too thin, so Gita does one useful thing Mr. Ade did not ask for and then says, plainly, that they noticed.
